policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O commits to data-center grid support program
items.summary: O pledged participation in a “Grid Protectors Program” to help support affordable, reliable electricity for communities near data centers, alongside testing for peak-hour energy demand reduction.

items.headline: V W-6 mission: autonomous navigation & thermal protection payload tests
items.summary: V’s W-6 mission description highlights autonomous hypersonic flight foundations and next-gen thermal protection tests, including an AutoNav-focused payload integration.

items.headline: O releases GPT-6 Cyber (critical cyber rating)
items.summary: O released GPT-6 Cyber to a subset of verified users, claiming its strongest cybersecurity capability rating (“critical”) and improved vulnerability finding/exploitation behavior under defined boundaries.

items.headline: O targets GitHub via Codex integration deal
items.summary: O reportedly plans to integrate Pierre’s code-storage function into Codex, potentially strengthening repository-aware coding workflows in Microsoft’s GitHub ecosystem.

items.headline: O raises bug-bounty payouts for critical findings
items.summary: O increased bug-bounty rewards, indicating readiness to quadruple payouts for “critical” security findings as AI attack risks grow.

items.headline: G re-valuation bid: $8B target highlighted
items.summary: Reporting says a G executive is pursuing a valuation target near $8B within about three months amid comments about inference-demand momentum and debt-market reliance.

items.headline: V Series D: $251M to scale space-based processing
items.summary: PR coverage says V announced a $251M Series D to scale space-based pharmaceutical processing, citing total raised to $598M—direct financing evidence supporting growth plans.

items.headline: G docs update: model deprecations & endpoint changes
items.summary: GroqDocs console deprecations page records recent model deprecations/endpoint changes (including Sep/Oct 2026 entries), indicating product surface evolution that can affect deployments.

items.headline: G public-sector/model-provider momentum noted amid industry chatter
items.summary: Industry coverage references G-related positioning (e.g., ecosystem and product timelines) alongside broader market developments; useful context but not a discrete fundamental change.

items.headline: V W-9 mission page: annual launches & reentries trend
items.summary: V’s W-9 mission details emphasize scaled operational cadence and “number of annual launches and reentries” increasing, supporting capacity-growth expectations.
